core_mechanics.name: Pay Anywhere
core_mechanics.description: 8+ matching symbols anywhere on 6x5 grid trigger win. No adjacency, no paylines.

core_mechanics.name: Tumble / Cascade
core_mechanics.description: Winning symbols disappear, new symbols fall from above. Continues until no new wins. Free re-spins within same paid spin.

core_mechanics.name: Random Multiplier (Base Game)
core_mechanics.description: Multiplier orbs land randomly. After all tumbles, sum of all orbs multiplies total win. Only applies if win occurred.

core_mechanics.name: Global Multiplier (Free Spins)
core_mechanics.description: Each multiplier orb on a winning spin adds to total multiplier for entire FS round. Total never resets during feature.
core_mechanics.example: Total 7 + orbs 3+6 on win 2.5x = 2.5 * (7+3+6) = 40x. New total = 16

optional_features.name: Ante Bet / Double Chance
optional_features.effect: Doubles scatter frequency, uses alternate reel set

optional_features.name: Bonus Buy / Buy Free Spins
optional_features.effect: Guaranteed 4 scatters on next spin, triggers 15 FS

flow_sequence: Player sets bet and spins 6x5 grid
Winning symbols removed, tumble cascade begins
Multiplier orbs may land (Zeus throws them)
After all tumbles: orb values summed and applied to win
4+ scatters trigger 15 Free Spins with global multiplier
During FS: multipliers accumulate, retriggers add +5 spins
